ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the root causes of this issue.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, and could lead to changes in how the program is administered.
